Fabrik is a spread out large map with an intense centred area, two one-way teleports are connected to the middle area at opposite sides of the map. The map has colour coded texturing for the key areas around yellow armor, red armor, and quad, to make navigation easier. Fabrik was started in the end of 2020, and the final version was made 4 months later, it is {{player|alice|flag=se}} second map designed for 4on4.

Location file is made by {{player|flintheart|flag=se}}
